newsitem.title: UK: British police seal off motorway in security alert.
newsitem.headline: British police seal off motorway in security alert.

text.p: British police on Friday sealed off large sections of one of the country's busiest motorways after a security alert, the BBC said.
On Monday this week much of the country's transport network was thrown into chaos after a series of bomb warnings from Irish Republican Army (IRA) guerrillas.

The BBC said large parts of both the M5 and M6 motorways in central England had been closed in both directions after police received a series of coded warnings, although it was not immediately clear whether the IRA was responsible.
The BBC also said the main New Street railway station in the central city of Birmingham had been shut.
The IRA, which wants British troops out of Northern Ireland, has disrupted rail and road networks several times in the run-up to May 1 elections.
